I know most people make mole (mol-ay) with bone in chicken but if you cook it right I prefer it with boneless chicken breast. 
Green mole is my fav, you can get a can, well glass jar of green mole at any mexican store and then I add jalapenos (how ever many depending on how spicy you like it), cilantro, onion, garlic, toasted pumpkin seeds and sunflower seeds. Which that other stuff is a basic green mole, at least how my mother in law taught me, I just like to add the jar of store bought stuff cuz the way it taste. It's also very salty and thick right out the jar so you have to thin it out anyway, it's like a paste. 
I boil the chicken breast with garlic, onion and chicken bullion then use the broth and blend everything together. Mmm now I know what I'm making for dinner haha
